# HR-V0 arm-interface source register

**PRELIMINARY—CANDIDATE SOURCES ONLY—NOT RELEASED FOR PROCUREMENT, FABRICATION, OR ENERGIZATION**

`arm-interface-source-register.csv` records the exact current primary pages used by R56. A product page establishes only the cited candidate identity and published dimensions. It does not release a purchase, certify received hardware, establish a torque or locking method, create a material allowable, or prove the assembled joint.

The register intentionally keeps the adapter material order code as `SELECTION REQUIRED`. Kaiser typical values are screening inputs, not design allowables. Supplier certificates, received dimensions, application calculations, physical proof and qualified disposition remain mandatory.
